identity_audit: Distinguish WorkRun, round, Work Attempt, logical message, transport delivery attempt, effect intent, effect attempt, recovery trigger, and journal record.
Redelivery preserves every canonical identity and byte; only the transport delivery attempt changes.
Work retry, repeat, revalidation, and effect retry allocate different identities under different owners.
Replay and resume allocate no identity and perform no external call.
owner_boundary_audit: Journal owner alone accepts structural history and recovery decision records.
Adapters own mechanics and truthful observations only.
Inbox, outbox, offset, acknowledgement, dead-letter state, and receipts are evidence, not accepted-history authority.
ARE evidence and ACI admission cannot become recovery or effect authority.
Every external effect requires a current exact-effect-owner permit; authority_ref is only an evidence locator.
admission_requirements: closed capability manifest with supported, unsupported, and prohibited features
canonical envelope schema plus immutable-identity fixtures
separate command, event, journal, inbox, outbox, and observation contracts
proof that only journal acceptance advances cursor and routing
recipient convergence evidence for unknown command acceptance
profile-specific atomicity, crash, ordering, replay, retention, backpressure, and acknowledgement evidence
current authority validation and exact-effect-owner binding
positive and negative conformance results with immutable runner/fixture digests

findings.repair: bind one accepted-history owner before admission; no transport state may advance cursor or routing
publish a closed identity and transition table
redeliver only with recipient convergence and current authority evidence; unknown effects reconcile
make authority_ref non-authorizing and revalidate current basis at acceptance/effect boundaries
require immutable admission record binding implementation, configuration, profile, owner, evidence, prohibitions, and validity epoch
replay is route-free reducer reconstruction with zero effects and allocations
keep independently admitted semantic evidence optional and authority_effect none
capability absence is fatal at admission; no silent fallback

blockers: No adapter/profile pair may be admitted until accepted-history and journal/domain-truth ownership is selected.
No effectful adapter may be admitted until exact-effect permit/outcome/reconciliation contracts are selected.
No profile may be used until identity, capability schema, admission record, and negative fixtures exist and pass.
Reviewed documentation proves no runtime conformance.
residue: Journal structural truth versus work-owned domain truth remains open.
handoff_note: Recovery semantics constrain the adapter design but do not admit a transport.
mutation_statement: Read-only; no files or external systems were modified.
